title: Marvel Cinematic Universe
note: Written by Claude for Watch Together. Moments are approximate (fraction of the runtime, in scene order). Production facts, no spoilers beyond the moment.

items.fact: The film opens to AC/DC's 'Back in Black' - Iron Man's music has leaned on AC/DC ever since.
Robert Downey Jr. was a risky casting choice in 2008; director Jon Favreau fought for him.
Much of the dialogue was improvised - the script wasn't finished when filming began.
Director Jon Favreau also plays Tony's driver and bodyguard, Happy Hogan.
Stan Lee's cameo: Tony mistakes him for Hugh Hefner.
The post-credits scene with Samuel L. Jackson as Nick Fury launched the idea of a shared Marvel universe.
The opening was filmed in the Rocinha favela in Rio de Janeiro.
Edward Norton played Bruce Banner here; Mark Ruffalo took over from 'The Avengers' (2012) onward.
Stan Lee's cameo: he drinks a soda contaminated with Bruce's blood and gets sick.
Lou Ferrigno, the Hulk of the 1970s TV series, cameos as a security guard and voices the Hulk.
Tony Stark's surprise appearance at the end was one of the first MCU crossovers.
Don Cheadle replaced Terrence Howard as James 'Rhodey' Rhodes.
Scarlett Johansson's first appearance as Black Widow.
Tony props up his particle accelerator with a prototype of Captain America's shield.
The post-credits scene shows Thor's hammer in a New Mexico crater.
Kenneth Branagh directed - known for Shakespeare films, which suited Asgard's royal drama.
Tom Hiddleston originally auditioned for Thor before being cast as Loki.
Jeremy Renner's Clint Barton makes his first, brief appearance at the hammer site.
'Skinny Steve' was created by digitally shrinking Chris Evans and combining him with a body double.
The song 'Star Spangled Man' was written by Disney legend Alan Menken.
Joe Johnston directed, chosen partly for his period adventure 'The Rocketeer'.
The ending in modern Times Square leads straight into 'The Avengers'.
Written and directed by Joss Whedon; it brought six heroes from five films together for the first time.
Mark Ruffalo was the first actor to play the Hulk himself through motion capture.
The Hulk-vs-Loki 'puny god' moment got some of the biggest laughs in cinemas.
Stan Lee's cameo: a man on the news saying 'Superheroes in New York? Give me a break!'
The shawarma scene was filmed after the premiere - Chris Evans wore a prosthetic jaw to hide a beard grown for another film.
Director Shane Black sets many of his films at Christmas - this one too.
Tony's panic attacks follow the events of 'The Avengers' - the MCU's first look at a hero's trauma.
Ben Kingsley's Trevor Slattery returned years later in 'Shang-Chi'.
Tony's armour count reaches Mark 42 here - dozens of suits fly in for the finale.
Alan Taylor, a Game of Thrones director, directed this film.
Chris Evans makes a cameo when Loki shape-shifts into Captain America.
The mid-credits scene introduces Benicio del Toro's Collector and names an Infinity Stone.
Anthony and Joe Russo's first MCU film - they went on to direct 'Civil War', 'Infinity War' and 'Endgame'.
Steve's catch-up list changes by country: different releases list different local pop-culture items.
Robert Redford's casting nods to the 1970s political thrillers the Russos modelled the film on, like 'Three Days of the Condor'.
Stan Lee cameos as a Smithsonian security guard.
The 'Awesome Mix Vol. 1' soundtrack topped the Billboard 200 - a first for an album made only of previously released songs.
Bradley Cooper voices Rocket; director James Gunn's brother Sean Gunn did the on-set performance.
Vin Diesel recorded 'I am Groot' in several languages for international versions.
The post-credits scene brings back Howard the Duck.
James Spader played Ultron through motion capture as well as voice.
Part of the film was shot in Seoul, South Korea; Sokovia scenes used Italy's Aosta Valley.
Paul Bettany, the voice of JARVIS since 2008, finally appears on screen as Vision.
Mid-credits: 'Fine, I'll do it myself.'
The opening de-ages Michael Douglas to 1989 - an early showcase of the de-aging effects Marvel used later.
Edgar Wright developed the film for years before leaving; Peyton Reed directed and Paul Rudd co-wrote.
The finale's fight on a toy train set plays the scale joke to the full.
Chadwick Boseman's first appearance as T'Challa / Black Panther.
Tom Holland debuts as Spider-Man, after a deal between Marvel Studios and Sony.
The airport battle was the first scene shot with the IMAX version of the Arri Alexa digital camera.
Tilda Swinton plays the Ancient One; Benedict Cumberbatch's schedule was moved so he could do the film.
Stan Lee's cameo: reading Aldous Huxley's 'The Doors of Perception' on a bus.
The opening dance by Baby Groot is set to ELO's 'Mr. Blue Sky'.
Kurt Russell plays Ego; Sylvester Stallone appears as Stakar Ogord.
The film has five mid- and post-credits scenes.
Michael Keaton - Batman in 1989 and 'Birdman' - plays the Vulture.
Captain America's cheesy school PSA videos are a running gag through the film.
The final post-credits scene is a joke about patience.
Led Zeppelin's 'Immigrant Song', with its lyrics about Valhalla, plays in two fight scenes.
Director Taika Waititi also plays Korg through motion capture.
'He's a friend from work!' was suggested by a Make-A-Wish child visiting the set.
Jeff Goldblum improvised much of the Grandmaster's dialogue.
Ryan Coogler directed; it was the first superhero film nominated for Best Picture.
The film won Oscars for costume design, production design and Ludwig Göransson's score.
Kendrick Lamar curated the companion album 'Black Panther: The Album'.
Josh Brolin played Thanos through performance capture; the film is built around him as the main character.
The giant dwarf Eitri is played by Peter Dinklage.
Most actors got fake scripts or only their own pages to prevent leaks.
Infinity War and Endgame were filmed largely back to back.
Michelle Pfeiffer joins as Janet van Dyne, the original Wasp.
Michael Peña's Luis 'truth serum' story became a fan-favourite running gag.
The opening Marvel logo was redone as a tribute to Stan Lee, who died months before release.
Set in 1995 - Carol crash-lands into a Blockbuster Video store.
Samuel L. Jackson was digitally de-aged for the entire film.
Goose the 'cat' was played by several cats.
Stan Lee's cameo: reading the script of 'Mallrats' on a train.
Endgame briefly became the highest-grossing film of all time, before an 'Avatar' re-release took the record back.
The line came from Robert Downey Jr.'s own children.
The first time the full 'Avengers, assemble' line is said in an MCU film.
Filmed in Venice, Prague and London.
Jake Gyllenhaal plays Mysterio; his illusion sequences were built with heavy VFX.
J.K. Simmons returns as J. Jonah Jameson - the role he played in Sam Raimi's Spider-Man films.
Florence Pugh's Yelena Belova debuts here.
Yelena's teasing about Natasha's 'superhero landing' pose pokes fun at Marvel's own action clichés.
Cate Shortland directed; the story is set between 'Civil War' and 'Infinity War'.

names: shang chi and the legend of the ten rings
entries.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings (2021)

items.fact: The bus fight was choreographed by the late Brad Allan, a longtime member of Jackie Chan's stunt team.
Hong Kong legend Tony Leung plays Wenwu.
Ben Kingsley returns as Trevor Slattery from 'Iron Man 3'.
Chloé Zhao directed right after winning the Oscar for 'Nomadland'.
Zhao filmed much on real locations, including the Canary Islands, instead of green screen.
Harry Styles appears as Eros in the mid-credits scene.
Charlie Cox appears as Matt Murdock - his first MCU film appearance after Netflix's Daredevil.
Andrew Garfield publicly denied being in the film for months before release.
Willem Dafoe and Alfred Molina returned to their Sam Raimi-era roles.

names: doctor strange in the multiverse of madness
entries.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022)

items.fact: Sam Raimi, director of the 2000s Spider-Man trilogy and Evil Dead, returned to superhero films.
Bruce Campbell - a Raimi regular - cameos as the street vendor Pizza Poppa.
Patrick Stewart returns as Professor X in the Illuminati scene.
Thor's goats Toothgnasher and Toothgrinder come straight from Norse myth, where they pull Thor's chariot.
Christian Bale - Batman in The Dark Knight trilogy - plays Gorr the God Butcher.
The soundtrack leans heavily on Guns N' Roses, including 'Sweet Child o' Mine'.
The silent Marvel logo is a tribute to Chadwick Boseman, who died in 2020.
Namor's underwater kingdom Talokan was redesigned with Mesoamerican (Maya and Aztec) influences.
Rihanna's 'Lift Me Up' was written as a tribute to Boseman.

names: ant man and the wasp quantumania
entries.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania (2023)

items.fact: Much of the Quantum Realm was filmed on an LED 'Volume' stage, like the one used for The Mandalorian.
Bill Murray cameos as Lord Krylar.
The film opens with an acoustic version of Radiohead's 'Creep'.
The hallway fight is presented as one continuous shot, set to the Beastie Boys' 'No Sleep till Brooklyn'.
Iman Vellani continues as Kamala Khan from the Ms. Marvel series.
The flerken rescue is set to 'Memory' from the musical 'Cats'.
At about 105 minutes it is the shortest MCU film.
The opening fight is set to *NSYNC's 'Bye Bye Bye'.
It is the first R-rated film of the MCU and became the highest-grossing R-rated film ever.
Hugh Jackman finally wears the classic yellow-and-blue Wolverine suit.
Anthony Mackie's Sam Wilson headlines his first film as Captain America.
Harrison Ford took over Thaddeus Ross after William Hurt's death in 2022.
Florence Pugh performed the opening jump from Kuala Lumpur's Merdeka 118, one of the world's tallest buildings, on a rig.
Lewis Pullman plays Bob, a mysterious man the team keeps running into.
The asterisk in the title is a joke the film pays off at the end.
Set in a retro-futurist 1960s on 'Earth-828' - a nod to Jack Kirby's birthday, 28 August.
Pedro Pascal, Vanessa Kirby, Joseph Quinn and Ebon Moss-Bachrach play the Fantastic Four.
Matt Shakman, director of 'WandaVision', directed; Michael Giacchino composed the score.
